main.description: Creates an automation account in an organization, for CI to publish as, and returns its token, which the registry does not show again. The caller must be an admin of the organization. CI calls this registry's methods with the token in place of a service-auth token, as the account, and the registry writes the account's attestations of what it publishes. No one signs in to the account.

organization.description: The organization, whose handle is a scope on this registry.

name.description: The first label of the account's handle in the scope.

token.description: The token, which starts with zena_ci_.

errors.name: QuotaExceeded
errors.description: The organization has created as many packages and automation accounts as the registry allows.
